title: Trajectory of a Counter-Loop Escape
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ and $\Gamma$ have decidable equality, let $e:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an injection, let $M$ be a $k$-tape Turing machine, and let $a,ex\in S$ with $ex\ne a$. Let $R$ be a round contract for $M$ with anchor $a$ and escape set $\{\mathrm{some}(ex)\}$, and fix an input $x$. For an index $i$, a Boolean word $w$, a natural number $r_0<v(w)$, and a configuration $d$ of the counter-loop machine, suppose the last tape of $d$ stores the encoded word $w$ at offsets $q$ for $-1\le q\le |w|$, as specified by the buffer convention; every round with index $r\le r_0$ satisfies $R$'s round condition; and the endpoint of round $r_0$ has state $ex$. Then for every time $q$ up to the counter-loop contract's prescribed duration, there exist $r$ and $u$ such that either $r\le r_0$ and $u$ is at most the duration of round $r$, or $r=r_0+1$ and $u=0$, and the first $k$ work-tape head positions at time $q$ equal those of the run of $M$ from the start of round $r$ at time $u$.
hypotheses_covered: An injection from the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$
A $k$-tape machine $M$, anchor $a$, and state $ex$ distinct from $a$
A round contract for $M$ with anchor $a$ and escape set $\{\mathrm{some}(ex)\}$
The counter-loop contract precondition for $(i,w,r_0)$ and $d$: the specified encoded buffer contents on the last tape
$r_0$ is strictly less than the binary value of $w$
Every round with index $r\le r_0$ satisfies the round condition
The endpoint of round $r_0$ has state $ex$
replaced:
Let $M$ be a machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$, and let
$e:\\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding into its
symbol alphabet. Let $a,ex\in S$ be distinct, let $R$ be a round contract for $M$
anchored at $a$ with escape set $\{\mathrm{some}(ex)\}$, and fix an input word $x$. For
any index $i$, Boolean word $w$, and natural number $N$, consider an initial
configuration $d$ in the decrement-running state that satisfies the counter-loop
contract precondition: its extra tape agrees with the embedded word $w$ at every offset
$q$ with $-1\le q\le |w|$, $N$ is less than the binary value of $w$, the round
precondition holds for each round $r\le N$, every round with $r<N$ returns to state $a$,
and the endpoint of round $N$ has state $ex$. At every time $u$ up to the counter-loop
contract time, the positions of the original $k$ work-tape heads coincide with those at
some time $u'$ in some round $r$ of the original machine's orbit, where either $r\le N$
and $u'\le$ the duration of round $r$, or $r=N+1$ and $u'=0$.
